moments.title: The debut win
moments.text: Four days after being promoted from Toro Rosso, Max wins his very first race in Red Bull colours. Aged 18 years and 228 days — the youngest Grand Prix winner in history, a record that still stands.
moments.videoTitle: 2016 Spanish Grand Prix: Race Highlights — FORMULA 1

moments.title: The drive in the rain
moments.text: Interlagos, monsoon conditions, and a recovery from P16 to the podium in 16 laps — passing car after car around the outside while others crashed out. Widely called one of the greatest wet-weather drives ever seen.
moments.videoTitle: Max Verstappen's Mesmerising Drive In The Wet — FORMULA 1

moments.title: The final lap
moments.text: Level on points with Lewis Hamilton after 21 rounds, on fresh soft tyres for one last lap. Turn 5, lights out on the greatest title fight in a generation — and a first World Championship for the Netherlands.
moments.videoTitle: Race Highlights | 2021 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix — FORMULA 1

moments.title: 19 wins in a year
moments.text: Ten consecutive victories. Nineteen wins from twenty-two races. 575 points — a title won by the biggest margin in the sport's history. The most dominant season Formula 1 has ever seen, sealed at the Yas Marina finale.
moments.videoTitle: Race Highlights | 2023 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix — FORMULA 1
